scope.purpose: Map-point historical photo evidence for flood events, infrastructure impacts, dam releases and recurrent urban flooding.
initial_requested_locations: Mepe & Battor — Lower Volta — October 2023 Akosombo/Kpong spillage
Bawku/Pwalugu / Upper East — 2018 Bagre Dam spillage

important_policy.production_rule: Display/rehost only assets with verified rights that permit the intended FloodOps use. A technically working image URL is not itself a license.
important_policy.wikimedia_rule: For CC BY-SA assets, preserve creator attribution, source page, license URL and modification notice where applicable. Prefer self-hosting/caching an allowed copy over depending on permanent third-party hotlinks.
important_policy.restricted_media_rule: For UNICEF, UN, ModernGhana, Prime News and other restricted/unknown-rights sources, store evidence metadata and source-page URLs; do not mirror/proxy/display the photograph in production without rights clearance.
important_policy.geolocation_rule: Never assign an event-region image to a specific town unless the caption/metadata supports that town. Keep geo_confidence explicit.

recommended_photo_schema.display_rule: display_ready must be true only when individual-file rights and source metadata have been verified.
